title: Has anyone met The Watchers in Mall World?
content: I've dreamed about Mall World a few times, explored the Manor on the Hill, and explored where the mall takes on an antique look. But I've actually met and talked to a couple of people there. When I was little, I called them Dream Wizards, as that was how they dressed. Now that I'm older, I've started saying they're Watchers, but they still look like Wizards to me. The first time I met one was when I was maybe 5, and I was Lucid Dreaming for the first time. I found out that if I shake my head in the dream, I can wake up. So I play with this trick a couple of times, but then I see I'm not waking up anymore, and worse off, I'm falsely waking. When I realize this, a monster child starts chasing me, regular dream shenanigans, but I'm still lucid. This child was wearing orange rags, had black matted hair, and rows of shark teeth. I run from her, when I'm rescued by a man in a cloak and hat, who was wearing round glasses too. When the threat was dealt with, he told me how to wake up. By finding the Door that doesn't belong. It could be any door, but it just wouldn't match the area around it. Like a screen door for a porch in a castle wall. And every time since then, if I found myself stuck in a dream, I just had to find that out-of-place door, and I'd wake up every time. The second time I met one of these watchers was more recent, maybe mid-2024. I dreamed I was in The Mall, but this was a little different than the white walls and tile floor. There was polished wood. Like wood banisters, the tiles were polished wood in beautiful patterns, and there was stained glass. I thought it was a chapel at first, but it was still very Mall if you get my meaning. I keep wandering until I find stairs to a tower, going up to the top, I can see very elaborate clockwork details. Geers, pendulums, the whole shibang. That's when another Watcher or Wizard comes around the corner. He's not the original wizard I met, since his robes are more purple, and he wasn't wearing a hat or glasses. He stared at me and asked how I got there, and that I wasn't supposed to be there. I tried to explain, but he made a motion with his hand, and I woke up. So, I'm wondering if anyone has met these people. I'm actually seeing if I can make a book out of these experiences, but it's proving difficult to land on much for it. So, any details you guys can think of, I'd greatly appreciate it. \^\_\^
